outlook.title: Central Subtropical Atlantic
outlook.summary: A small area of low pressure located several hundred miles east of Bermuda has become better defined over the last 24 hours. Environmental conditions could become a little more conducive for further development in the next few days while the system moves slowly westward to southward over the subtropical Atlantic.

outlook.title: Southwest of Southwestern Mexico
outlook.summary: An area of low pressure could form well offshore of southwestern Mexico within the next few days. Environmental conditions appear conducive for some gradual development, and this system could become a tropical depression early next week while it moves slowly northwestward or northward.

outlook.title: Western East Pacific
outlook.summary: A tropical wave is producing disorganized showers and thunderstorms well to the south of the southern tip of the Baja California Peninsula.
